text.en:
Daybreak Kills spawn both an Empowering and Healing Rift on Enemy Death Location.

While standing in a Rift:
Solar Weapon Kills grant [?]% Class Ability Energy.

While your Class Ability Energy is Full:
Weapon Kills consume your Class Ability Energy and spawn a Empowering + Healing Rift at the Target's Location.

Daybreak Kills spawn both an Empowering and Healing Rift on Enemy Death Location.

While standing in a Rift:
Solar Weapon Kills grant [?]% Class Ability Energy.

While your Class Ability Energy is Full:
Weapon Kills consume your Class Ability Energy and spawn a Empowering + Healing Rift at the Target's Location.

Daybreak Kills spawn a Healing and Empowering Rift on Enemy Death Location.

Kills while your Class Ability Energy is full also spawn a Healing and Empowering Rift on Enemy Death Location. Consumes Class Ability Charge.

Solar Weapon Kills while standing in a Rift grant Class Ability Energy based on <link enemy rank [https://d2clarity.page.link/combatant] />:
• 9%: Tier 1 Minors
• 13%: Tier 2 Minors, Tier 1 Elites(?)
• 15%: Enemy Players
• 20%: Tier 3 Minors, Tier 2 Elites(?)
• 30%: Tier 4 Minors, Tier 3-4 Elites(?)
• 40%: Minibosses 
• 50%: Bosses
